scope: cols entity writer format versus our 0x671650 observations

sequence: eType at field 0 is raw byte 1 (codec -77)
positions at fields 1/2/5 are 1 bit + signed16
angles at fields 3/7/26 are 2 bits (0) + raw LE16

our_observations.entity_table_0x671650: 1 bit table-present, 1 bit form, 8-bit count at byte164, 12-bit entity ids
differences: cols has no count byte; it writes the entity number directly
cols uses an 11-bit entity number; we measured 12 bits
cols uses a 6-bit last field index; our byte164 looked like an 8-bit bound

conclusion: 3.3.3.3 and 1649370 differ in the entity-table header, so the cols writer cannot be copied verbatim; however the field-stream grammar (last bound + distance + codec) matches what the decoder expects and remains the best template
